implement.summary: Redeploy any past healthy version with pinned digests, and export any recorded deployment as a Nomad HCL jobspec, in API 0.9.0 and the console

approach: Every deployment records its definition. Redeploying a healthy past deployment saves that definition and runs the normal deploy with its digests pinned, after a registry existence check. Export renders Translate's job as HCL with a hand-written pure writer and a header listing cluster prerequisites.
